target_customer: Commercial real estate brokerages and investment teams
problem: Brokers spend 20+ hours a week building deal decks, underwriting and marketing materials by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS with proprietary data, pricing not public
product_category: AI copilot for commercial real estate (Henry Deal, Henry Decks)

founders.name: Sammy Greenwall
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; he started as a CRE analyst per Commercial Observer.

founders.name: Adam Pratt
previous_startups: Halligan (fire department SaaS, acquired by Vector Solutions 2019)

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM document generation, data ingestion of brokerage files and Excel integration; accuracy requirements raise difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Each firm's past decks and deals feed the system and a two week onboarding embeds it; the generic tooling is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crexi launched an AI offering memorandum tool in May 2026 per a search snippet; no acquisition of Henry found.

market_need_then: CRE brokers build many pitch decks manually; the founder says he built dozens as an analyst. Company reports 150+ firms and $150B of deal value by 2026.

pivots.to: End to end deal platform with underwriting (Henry Deal)
pivots.why: Expansion after Series A per press; stated need to move faster

outcome_analysis: Henry went from a June 2024 launch to 150+ brokerage customers, a $4.3M seed in February 2025 and a $16.5M Series A in 2026 led by FirstMark. Founder market fit from a CRE analyst turned Lev executive and a repeat founder drove a focused wedge on deal decks that then widened to underwriting. The main risk is generic AI tools and portals like Crexi copying the feature.
notes: Series A date conflict: Commercial Observer says June, pulse2 says July 31 2026; month recorded as 2026-07. Sourav is named as co-founder in the YC launch post without a company bio; omitted. Aggregator total $20.8M is consistent with rounds. Competition near the batch was not found in dated sources, so list is empty. Education only for Greenwall.
